name: band-of-burning-verdict-enter-draw
notes:
Band of Burning Verdict (7mmve2l328, REGALIA/ITEM/TAMER accessory -- CardType() confirms 'REGALIA,ITEM', not ally, despite the card's role as Guo Jia-deck support): 'On Enter: Draw a card.' Materialized for real from hand with a TAMER Guo Jia champion, FIRE element access, and an Animal/Beast ally (Cheerful Slime) already on the field. Verified live: the deck count drops by exactly 1 after materializing, in a single FSM play action with no follow-up prompt.

FIXED (previously two confirmed engine bugs, now corrected -- see band-of-burning-verdict-play-without-tamer-bonus and band-of-burning-verdict-rest-buff-requires-activation for the fixtures that positively demonstrate the fix): the card's printed '[Class Bonus] [REST]: Target Animal or Beast ally you control gets +1 POWER and gains true sight until end of turn' clause had its condition and body generated into the wrong dispatch tables entirely -- (1) GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php activateCardPrereqs['7mmve2l328:0'] wrongly gated PLAYING the card on IsClassBonusActive($player,['TAMER']) and an Animal/Beast ally already being on the field, neither of which is a printed restriction on materializing this item; (2) cardActivatedAbilities['7mmve2l328:0'] (the [REST] buff body) was dispatched unconditionally by OnCardActivated() immediately after the card entered the field, with no REST cost ever paid. Fixed by overriding both wrong entries to a no-op/always-legal pair in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (the established convention for correcting an existing-but-wrong generated dispatch-table entry, per that file's 'Destroy target X' precedents), and registering the buff as a proper activateAbilityAbilities/activateAbilityPrereqs entry in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php (the established convention for a missing entry, matching the Charm of Anticipation precedent -- also a REGALIA/ITEM card), reached only via an explicit later ActivateAbility() call. This fixture now needs only the single FSM play action since the bogus MZCHOOSE no longer blocks the On Enter draw from resolving in the same action. Break/restore verified: reverting the fix files reproduces the original bug (the play-without-tamer-bonus fixture's play gets blocked, and this fixture's own single-action deck-count assertion fails because the still-auto-firing bogus MZCHOOSE stalls the On Enter draw until a second action answers it -- restoring the fix makes all three pass again).
